South Korea's Kospi fell 5.28% in one day, and the trigger was AI data centers in America.

SK Hynix fell about 9.5% and Samsung about 7.6%, according to Korea JoongAng Daily. Both make the memory chips AI data centers run on. After Democrats won control of Congress in the US midterms, investors expect more limits on building new data centers. Goldman Sachs estimates about 45% of planned new US capacity could face pauses.

But the AI trade split rather than crashed: on Wednesday chip stocks fell while Microsoft hit a record high and Amazon and Alphabet rose. Slower building can mean smaller bills for the companies paying for it.

Why it matters: the biggest new risk to the AI build-out is permission to build, not the technology.

Source: Korea JoongAng Daily, Nov 5, 2026.
